an10.167:1.1: tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo tadahuposathe sīsanhāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allakusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya bhagavato avidūre ekamantaṃ ṭhito hoti.
an10.167:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā jāṇussoṇiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tadahuposathe sīsanhātaṃ navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthaṃ allakusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ
an10.167:2.3: kiṃ nu tvaṃ brāhmaṇa tadahuposathe sīsanhāto navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivattho allakusamuṭṭhiṃ ādāya ekamantaṃ ṭhito
an10.167:3.1: yathākathaṃ pana brāhmaṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.167:3.2: idha bho gotama brāhmaṇā tadahuposathe sīsanhātā navaṃ khomayugaṃ nivatthā allena gomayena paṭhaviṃ opuñjitvā haritehi kusehi pattharitvā antarā ca velaṃ antarā ca agyāgāraṃ seyyaṃ kappenti
an10.167:3.3: te taṃ rattiṃ tikkhattuṃ paccuṭṭhāya pañjalikā aggiṃ namassanti
an10.167:3.5: pahutena ca sappitelena navanītena aggiṃ santappenti
an10.167:3.6: tassā ca rattiyā accayena paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena brāhmaṇe santappenti
an10.167:3.7: evaṃ kho bho gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hotīti
an10.167:4.1: aññathā kho brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hoti aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti
an10.167:4.2: yathākathaṃ pana bho gotama ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti
an10.167:4.3: sādhu vata me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.167:5.1: tenahi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
an10.167:5.2: evaṃ bhoti kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
an10.167:6.2: pāṇātipātassa kho pāpako vipāko diṭṭheceva dhamme abhisamparāyañcāti
an10.167:8.3: so iti paṭisaṃkhāya kāmesu micchācāraṃ pajahati
an10.167:15.5: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotīti.
an10.167:16.1: aññathā bho gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī hoti aññathā capana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti
an10.167:16.2: imissā ca bho gotama ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇiyā brāhmaṇānaṃ paccorohaṇī kallaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ
an10.167:16.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃgatanti.
